title: Minimum Number of Refueling Stops
description: Find the minimum number of refueling stops to reach the target, given an initial fuel and a list of stations.
pseudocode:
1. maxHeap.push(startFuel)
2. stops = 0, currentPosition = 0
3. for each station in stations:
4.   dist = station.pos - currentPosition
5.   while maxHeap.size > 0 and currentFuel < dist:
6.     currentFuel += maxHeap.pop()
7.     stops++
8.   currentFuel -= dist
9.   maxHeap.push(station.fuel)
10.  currentPosition = station.pos

steps.note: Initialize maxHeap with starting fuel of 10.
Arriving at first station at position 10 with 10 fuel.
Travel to station, fuel reduces to 0.
Fuel is 0, need fuel to reach target 100.
Refuel from heap, total fuel becomes 30.
